preserve: v1, v2 and v3 challenge DATA is validated before any request: unique ids, one split per family, typed block kinds, criteria shapes and gold labels
the request plan sends the passage and only criterion-scoped or pinned reference context, never general item context
a section heading is judged over complete ordered source-bound chunks; one fail chunk fails it, all pass chunks pass it, else uncertain
a prior report resumes only when data, rubric, model, endpoint, serving identity, request policy, captured request and raw response all match
a decision is the predicted option only when its probability exceeds the diagnostic minimum, else uncertain
allowed_deltas: the hosted classifier wire shape (intoBatchRequest, outOfBatchReply) is imported from tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict, its one home, instead of a checkout an environment variable names
the place-reports helper and its words file are not carried: endpoint and model are the caller's settings
